description:
Join the Percent Ashitaba Affiliate Program — share wellness with your community and earn 15% commission on every order.

About our brand and products:
Founded in 1991, Percent Ashitaba was built on a simple belief: true wellness begins with nature.
Developed by Hachi Jo Island Corporation and distributed in the U.S. by Tu Luc International, Inc., our mission is to bring authentic, plant-based Japanese wellness products to families worldwide.

Starting with Ashitaba Tea, grown in the volcanic soil of Hachi Jō Island, Japan, we preserve the plant’s vitality through careful roasting and blending.

Our product line includes:
• Percent Ashitaba Tea – Pure, caffeine-free, pesticide-free. Supports vitality and long-term wellness.
• Percent Spirulina – Rich in plant protein and vitamin B12. A natural source of energy.
• Percent Barley Green – Made from young Australian barley grass, rich in chlorophyll and fiber.
• Percent 36 Energy Booster – A balanced blend of 36 grains, herbs, and superfoods for daily vitality.

💸 How affiliates earn:
Earn 15% commission on every qualified referral order made through your affiliate link. No coupon code required — all tracked sales are automatically credited.

🎁 Customer gift promotions:
Your referred customers enjoy exclusive gifts, such as free Percent Ashitaba Tea (1g x 40 bags) or 36 Energy Booster (30g x 10) — enhancing real product experience and loyalty.

🌎 Additional information:
• Official affiliate domain: https://affiliate.ashitaba.com
• Commission: 15% per qualified order
• Cookie duration: 30 days
• Payout: Monthly via PayPal on the 15th (after refund and verification)
payout_period: Monthly via PayPal on the 15th of each month, after refund and order verification.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Percent Ashitaba!

Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.

These terms and conditions apply to individuals who participate in the Program as affiliates (“you”) referring customers to purchase products from Percent Ashitaba — a brand developed by Hachi Jo Island Corporation (HJI) and distributed in the United States by Tu Luc International, Inc. (“we”, “us”, or “merchant”).

By participating in the Program, you agree to use it in the manner specified below. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in any way.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your application.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Your affiliate link is automatically generated, but you may also generate links for specific products or collections.
If a person clicks on another affiliate’s link and then clicks on yours, the most recent link (yours) will count.

Each affiliate may be assigned a coupon code, as specified on your dashboard. If a customer both clicks on your affiliate link and uses your coupon, only one commission will apply. Affiliates not assigned a coupon may not promote one independently.

Affiliates may advertise our website via online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, or via offline methods such as flyers or print media.

3. Commissions and Payment

You earn commissions based on the net sale value after discounts, excluding tax and shipping.
Payments are made monthly via PayPal after the refund period and verification of eligible transactions.

Transactions resulting in chargebacks, cancellations, or refunds will not be paid. All commission statuses are displayed in your Affiliate Dashboard under the Commission and Payment tabs.

4. Marketing Materials

Approved marketing materials (banners, logos, and promotional media) are available under the Marketing Tools section. Affiliates must use only official materials provided by Percent Ashitaba.

5. Cookie Tracking

We use cookies to track customer referrals.
Tracking duration is stated on the registration form (e.g., 30 days).
If a customer disables or deletes cookies, we cannot track their purchase, and no commission can be paid.

6. Removal from the Program

To request removal from the Program, email affiliate@ashitaba.com.
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts engaging in fraudulent, misleading, or non-compliant activities.

7. Legal Notice

This Program is managed by Tu Luc International, Inc., the authorized U.S. distribution agent for Hachi Jo Island Corporation.
By joining, you acknowledge that participation does not create an employment or agency relationship.

For questions, contact affiliate@ashitaba.com.
Thank you for partnering with Percent Ashitaba. Let’s share health and wellness together!
